name: discord_list_members
description: List members of a guild (paginated). Provide `guild_id`; optional `limit` (1-1000, default 100) and `after` (paginate: pass the highest user id from the previous page). REQUIRES the GUILD_MEMBERS privileged intent enabled on the bot application.

limit.description: Max members to return, 1-1000. Defaults to 100.

after.description: Return members with a user id greater than this (pagination cursor).
